text: Milvus is an open-source vector database suitable for everything from a notebook demo to web-scale search
quote: Milvus is an open-source vector database that suits AI applications of every size from running a demo chatbot in Jupyter notebook to building web-scale search that serves billions of users.

text: Create a local Milvus database instantly by instantiating a MilvusClient pointed at a local file
quote: To create a local Milvus vector database, simply instantiate a `MilvusClient` by specifying a file name to store all data

text: Accepts raw text input and automatically converts it to sparse embeddings without manual embedding generation
quote: it simplifies vector searches by accepting raw text input, automatically converting your text data into sparse embeddings without the need to manually generate vector embeddings

text: Supports searching across multiple vector fields by running several ANN searches simultaneously
quote: Milvus supports this by allowing search on multiple vector fields, conducting several Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) searches simultaneously

text: Search requests can include metadata filters applied before ANN search to shrink the search scope
quote: You can include filtering conditions in a search request so that Milvus conducts metadata filtering before conducting ANN searches, reducing the search scope from the whole collection to only the entities matching the specified filtering co

text: Offers four multi-tenancy strategies with different scalability/isolation/flexibility trade-offs
quote: Milvus supports four multi-tenancy strategies, each offering a different trade-off between scalability, data isolation, and flexibility

text: RBAC lets admins finely control user operations at collection, database, and instance levels
quote: With RBAC, you can finely control the operations users can perform at the collection, database, and instance levels, enhancing data security

text: An MCP server lets AI apps run vector search, manage collections, and retrieve data via natural-language commands
quote: allowing AI applications to perform vector searches, manage collections, and retrieve data using natural language commands—without writing custom database queries

text: Same client-side code runs Milvus Lite on a laptop, Standalone in Docker, or Distributed on Kubernetes at billion-scale
quote: With the same client-side code, you can run GenAI apps with Milvus Lite on a laptop or Jupyter Notebook, or Milvus Standalone on Docker container, or Milvus Distributed on massive scale Kubernetes cluster serving billions of vectors in prod

text: Milvus scaled from billion-scale vectors in 2022 to tens of billions in 2023 with consistent stability
quote: In 2022, Milvus supported billion-scale vectors, and in 2023, it scaled up to tens of billions with consistent stability

text: Official pymilvus Python SDK provides a MilvusClient for building applications
quote: This installs `pymilvus`, the Python SDK for Milvus. Use `MilvusClient` to create a client

text: Milvus delivers 30%-70% better performance than FAISS and HNSWLib per vendor benchmarks
quote: Compared to popular implementations like FAISS and HNSWLib, Milvus delivers 30%-70% better performance.

text: Supports a Standalone deployment mode for single-machine setups
quote: Milvus also supports Standalone mode for single machine deployment.

text: Milvus Lite shares the same API as Standalone/Distributed and covers CRUD, sparse/dense search, filtering, and hybrid search
quote: Milvus Lite shares the same API with Milvus Standalone and Distributed, and covers most of the features such as vector data persistence and management, vector CRUD operations, sparse and dense vector search, metadata filtering, multi-vector

text: Milvus Lite is a lightweight Python library ideal for quick prototyping in notebooks or running on edge devices
quote: Milvus Lite is a Python library that can be easily integrated into your applications. As a lightweight version of Milvus, it’s ideal for quick prototyping in Jupyter Notebooks or running on edge devices

text: Client search API accepts a batch of query vectors and a result limit for ANN search
quote:
res = client.search(
